title: A Human-in-the-Loop Autonomous Agent for Industry Time Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2608.30976v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Real-world time-series forecasting is rarely a one-shot model invocation: practitioners must formulate tasks, connect data and models, incorporate domain expertise, assess prediction plausibility, and communicate uncertainty. Specialized forecasting models provide strong numerical predictions but usually operate in fixed pipelines, while general-purpose large language model (LLM) agents often lack forecasting-specific checks, constraints, and stopping rules. We present CastClaw, a human-in-the-loop autonomous forecasting system built through forecasting-oriented harness engineering. CastClaw connects data, specialized models, analytical tools, user input, and a versioned execution record in one runtime. Users specify the target, horizon, constraints, and hypotheses in natural language. translated_title: 面向工业时间序列预测的人机协同自主智能体
translated_abstract: 现实世界中的时间序列预测很少是一次性的模型调用：从业者需要制定任务、连接数据与模型、融入领域专业知识、评估预测的合理性，并传达不确定性。专业化的预测模型能够提供强大的数值预测，但通常在固定流程中运行；而通用的大语言模型（LLM）智能体往往缺乏针对预测任务的检验机制、约束条件和停止规则。我们提出了 CastClaw，一个通过面向预测的工程化框架构建的人机协同自主预测系统。CastClaw 在同一运行时环境中连接数据、专业模型、分析工具、用户输入以及带版本控制的执行记录。用户可以用自然语言指定预测目标、时间跨度、约束条件和假设。CastClaw 从用户提供的或模型生成的预测出发，检验时间模式与用户约束；当证据缺失时，它会检索相关上下文信息以补充判断依据。
tldr: 该论文提出了 CastClaw，一个面向工业时间序列预测的人机协同自主智能体系统，它在统一运行时中整合数据、专业预测模型、分析工具与用户输入，能够检验时间模式与用户约束、在证据不足时自动检索补充信息，并支持用户以自然语言交互式地制定和迭代优化预测任务。
en_tdlr: The paper presents CastClaw, a human-in-the-loop autonomous forecasting agent that integrates data, specialized models, analytical tools, and user input in a single runtime, checking temporal patterns and user constraints and retrieving missing evidence to support interactive, real-world time-series forecasting tasks.
